Subject: Post-demo: Draft MAP technical evaluation specification + next steps

Hi John / Aisha —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a concrete ask to keep the MAP momentum going: below is a draft of the MAP milestone we discussed ("Technical evaluation plan") with proposed success criteria, owners, and immediate dependencies. Please review and confirm any missing items on your side so we can lock dates.

High-level objective:
- Run an end-to-end technical benchmark that validates latency, cost, and response quality against a representative prompt set for your triage assistant workflows. Goal: be confident on a recommended model + serving configuration within the MAP timeframe.

Draft success criteria (customer-targeted):
- Latency: p50 <= 120 ms, p95 <= 420 ms for 32-token answers in our staging network when served from us-east-1 (Redwood Dedicated config).
- Cost: tokenized cost target <= $0.45 per 1k input+output tokens at planned throughput (50 TPS sustained burst to 200 TPS).
- Quality: >90% pass rate on your 1200-case acceptance prompt set measured by your current rubric (intent & slot extraction accuracy + hallucination flag rate).
- Stability: no more than 2% error rate (timeouts/500s) during a continuous 30-minute load window.

Model shortlist (initial):
- Llama-3-70B-instruct (quantized 4-bit) — expected best quality; heavier resource needs.
- Mistral-Instruct-22B (int8) — balance of quality and cost.
- Falcon-40B-instruct (quantized) — alternative to test for different generation patterns.

Immediate dependencies / asks for HealthGrid:
- Provide final prompt set and acceptance rubric (sample file referenced as healthgrid-sample-prompts.json) by Oct 4.
- Confirm whether you prefer Redwood to run the benchmark (on Dedicated trial) or to run tests in your staging environment (we can provide runner scripts).
- Share any compliance constraints for test payloads (PII masking rules) and the names of the Eng/SRE owners who must be present for test windows.
- Procurement timeline: procurement lead to confirm PO targeted dates (impacts MAP close).

Proposed owners (Redwood):
- Benchmark execution & measurement: Marissa Cole (BenchOps)
- Serving config & model tuning: Rafael Mendes (Sales/Platform liaison)
- Cost modeling & billing estimates: Karthik Iyer (Pricing)

Target dates (draft):
- Customer provides prompts & rubric: by 2026-10-04
- Redwood / HealthGrid align execution plan & resources: by 2026-10-07
- Benchmarks executed: 2026-10-11 -> 2026-10-13
- Readout & model recommendation: by 2026-10-15
- MAP technical milestone signoff: by 2026-10-22

I attached a one-tab MAP draft (map-draft-technical-eval-v0.2.xlsx) that converts the above into a checklist you can comment on.

Next concrete next steps:
1) John/Aisha: confirm prompts owner & share file by Oct 4.
2) HealthGrid: confirm whether Redwood runs the test (recommended for parity) by Oct 5.
3) Internal: Marissa/Karthik — if Redwood runs benchmarks, please confirm available test windows next week (we should reserve 2 x 2 hour slots).

Thanks — Rafael

-- 
Rafael Mendes

- Procurement: I looped in Aisha (copied here). She'll confirm PO timing but preliminary estimate is mid-Nov for a standard SaaS agreement unless we expedite.

- Internal owners: Myself (Eng lead) and Aisha Khan (Procurement) will be the points on our side.

We can commit to sending the final prompt set + rubric by Oct 4.

Thanks — John
